criteria.title: Presentation evidence
criteria.description: Slides and narration notes explain the question, method, evidence and limitations for an engineering audience. The local text grader does not assess visual styling or spoken delivery.

criteria.title: Individual written defence
criteria.description: Two typed answers about the student's own repository identify specific cells/results and explain the decisions. Credit is based on the submitted evidence; live questioning is formative.

criteria.title: Reflection
criteria.description: 500 words. Specific about what changed since Week 1, what remains difficult, and two concrete Semester 2 goals. Generic reflection scores low.

criteria.title: AI-use declaration
criteria.description: Present, complete and plausible against the repository history.
